retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic composite featuring a large-scale portrait overlaying a scenic landscape with a rider on horseback, utilizing high-contrast serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition where a close-up, warm-toned male portrait in a cowboy hat dominates the right side, partially transparent over a wide-angle shot of a girl riding a black horse through a sunlit mountain valley.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the large foreground face and the small mid-ground rider
Warm sunlight on the portrait vs. cool blue tones of the distant mountains
Text placement framing the top and bottom edges of the central action
Diagonal eye path from the man's gaze down to the horse and rider
coreInvariants: Presence of a cowboy hat as a genre signifier

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale male portrait anchored to the top right; smaller full-body rider anchored to the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the brim of the cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large face, follows the hat brim to the title, then drops to the rider and horse in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky in the top left provides breathing room for the primary title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and blues from the landscape
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and tan hat colors
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black of the horse and crisp white of the rider's shirt
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the landscape with high value (brightness) in the sky and skin highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal bars on specific characters like 'A'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' features a stylized, elongated crossbar that tapers into a sharp point resembling a blade or wing.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a clean, spaced-out sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the cinematic, classical serif feel with sharp terminals.
Provides a similar epic, uppercase-only aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a composite image with a large, warm-toned male face in a cowboy hat on the right, blended into a landscape of a girl riding a black horse in a green valley with blue mountains.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a sharp, high-contrast serif font at the top left, ensuring the 'A' has a custom elongated crossbar. Place secondary credits in a spaced-out sans-serif at the top and bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait blended naturally into the landscape?
Does the 'A' in the title have the specific elongated crossbar?
Is the tracking on the secondary text wide enough?
Is the color balance between warm foreground and cool background maintained?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the mountain blue tones
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending of the portrait edge
Verify the serif sharpness in the title
Ensure the horse and rider are clearly defined against the grass
Confirm the wide tracking in the metadata text
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Composite + Large Portrait Overlay + Sharp Serif Display Type + Wide Landscape Background
